subject: ela
name: English Language Arts
title: Grade 11 English Language Arts: English 11
overview: Grade 11 English Language Arts immerses students in collegiate literary analysis, rhetorical critique of historical documents, research synthesis, and sophisticated composition.
competencies: Evaluate complex themes, character motivations, and literary craft in seminal literary works.
Analyze rhetorical devices, persuasive arguments, and philosophical premises in foundational texts.
Compose well-substantiated research papers and argumentative essays adhering to academic citations.
Engage in sophisticated scholarly seminar discourse, defending evidence-based conclusions.

modules.title: American Literary Voices & Foundational Historical Rhetoric
modules.description: Analyzing seminal American historical documents, early American literary movements (Transcendentalism, Realism), and the American Dream.

topics.title: Foundational American Political Rhetoric
topics.description: Critiquing constitutional debates, the Federalist Papers, Lincoln's speeches, and transcendentalist essays (Emerson, Thoreau).

topics.title: The American Dream: Modernism & Social Realism
topics.description: Analyzing novels and plays depicting the disillusionment and promise of the 20th century (e.g. The Great Gatsby, Death of a Salesman).

modules.title: The Harlem Renaissance & Diverse American Perspectives
modules.description: Examining the artistic, poetic, and musical explosion of the Harlem Renaissance, Southern Gothic literature, and contemporary voices.

topics.title: Poetic Voice and Cultural Identity in the Harlem Renaissance
topics.description: Analyzing poetry by Langston Hughes, Claude McKay, and prose by Zora Neale Hurston examining race and justice.

topics.title: Southern Gothic and Contemporary Narrative Fiction
topics.description: Analyzing flawed characters, atmospheric regional settings, and generational moral decay in 20th-century American prose.

modules.title: Advanced Research Inquiry & Critical Policy Synthesis
modules.description: Conducting in-depth research into pressing public policy questions, synthesizing complex arguments, and crafting collegiate essays.

topics.title: Formulating Complex Arguments with Nuanced Counterclaims
topics.description: Writing authoritative argumentative essays anticipating complex objections and maintaining formal academic voice.

topics.title: Multi-Source Investigative Research Paper
topics.description: Conducting extensive research utilizing peer-reviewed academic journals, synthesizing findings, and providing rigorous APA/MLA citation.
